column3: 条件：アーシー、ルーシーが居る　＆　場所がシベリア
column4: Condition: Arcy Julietta and Lucy are present & location is Siberia.

column3: 寒い、吹雪で寒い・・お菓子がカチカチと怒る
column4: Cold, it's cold in the blizzard... candy snaps sharply in anger.

column3: アイスをもらうとカチカチでも喜ぶ。寒くても平気で食べる
column4: When given ice cream, even the stiff candy is happy. They eat it without worry even in the cold.

column3: 二人の情報、魔人バークスハムの使徒、主の命令で魔王ガイの後継者を見つける為に
column4: Their information: Apostles of the Fiend Burksham, dispatched by their lord's orders to find the successor of Demon King Gai.

column3: 世界中に派遣されていたの、我々３姉妹なの、６００年ほど前の話かな
column4: We three sisters were sent all over the world, that was about 600 years ago.

column3: もう一人はマーシーという、確か最後の連絡はこのシベリア方面からだったけど
column4: There was another named Mercy Julietta; if I recall, the last contact was from the Siberian area.

column3: どこにいったんだろうね
遭難して死んだのかもしれないねと行っていたら、見つかる　仲間になる
column4: We said she might have been lost and died, but then she was found and joined us.
